Subject: Partner claim check — initial matrix attached

Team —

Attached is a first-pass claim matrix for the NexaCloud alliance pipeline (claim_matrix_v1.xlsx). I swept the current partner-sourced opportunities and matched them to our internal AEs and partner SDRs. Please do a quick claim check for the accounts you own or are working with:

- Flag any accounts you believe should be owned by a partner motion (co-sell / referral) instead of direct.
- Mark account conflicts where an internal AE is already engaged and note the primary contact.
- Add brief notes in the "Rationale" column if you recommend reassigning an owner.

Deadline: EOD Wed (5/19) — I want to lock the routing rules draft for the partner team sync on Friday.

Attachments: claim_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Partner claim check — initial matrix attached

Monica —

Thanks for pulling this together. I ran a quick pass and uploaded a cleaned CSV (nexacloud_account_list.csv) with inline notes. High-level:

- ACME Corp (ACME-ID-7721) — currently assigned to AE Tom Hargreaves (pilot outreach). Recommend we leave with AE for now; partner should be referrer only.
- Meridian Health — conflict: both partner SDR and internal AE have active open discovery. Recommend co-sell with partner lead owner; set routing to partner if partner engages before demo is scheduled.
- Octavian Analytics — claim for NexaCloud looks valid; partner should own routing if they participate in first touch.

I'll add a short rules draft in the Google doc but want to highlight one tricky edge: multi-geo accounts where partner has EU presence but AE is US—need clear precedence (region->existing engagement->partner preference).

Hi Monica / team,

Thanks for sharing the matrix and looping us in. A few quick confirms from NexaCloud's side:

- We're happy to accept co-sell ownership on Octavian Analytics and Meridian Health provided the routing rules allow partner-first engagement windows.
- For ACME Corp, we don't have an active relationship — will adopt referral only.

Two asks from us so we can finalize:
1) Can you share the priority rules you plan to use when both partner and AE engage? (region, existing AE contact, timing)
2) Do you have a dedicated intake URL or HubSpot form for partner-submitted opps so the source is tracked on creation?

I can sign off on the matrix once we have the routing rules documented. Attached our partner ID and the partnership intake play (nexa_partner_playbook.pdf).

Best,
Priyanka Sinha
Head of Strategic Alliances
NexaCloud
priynka@nexacloud.com

Cc: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Final routing matrix and small routing rules — ready for partner sync

Priyanka / team —

Appreciate the quick turn. Based on Marcus' notes and your confirmation, we've finalized the routing matrix and a short rules draft. Summary:

- Primary precedence order (applies per-opportunity): 1) Existing AE with active demo/proposal > 2) Partner-first if partner submits lead within 7 calendar days of first touch > 3) Region-pref (partner presence) for multi-geo accounts.
- Co-sell confirmation: Partner will receive lead credit and be set as "Partner Owner" in HubSpot when they submit via the partner intake form (HS-Contact-83492).
- Escalations: If an ownership dispute remains after automated rules, PS Ops (camila.reyes) will triage within 48 hours and escalate to Head of Partner GTM if needed.

I've attached the finalized files and a short routing_rules_draft.md. Drive link to live matrix: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2BclaimMatrix

Next steps:
- Priyanka: confirm acceptance by EOD Tue (5/25) so we can enable partner routing on Wed.
- Marcus/Laura: update any AE-owned accounts that you want to keep outside partner routing by EOD Mon (5/24).

Attachments: claim_matrix_v1.xlsx, routing_rules_draft.md

Thanks — looking forward to the sync Friday.

Monica Patel
Senior Partner Ops
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
